name: Vanderbilt University
header:
Vanderbilt University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• General GRE not considered; math GRE highly recommended.
• International waiver request follows completed submission, but before deadline.
• English exemption can fail with foreign transfer credits.
• The primary-faculty roster mixes research, teaching, emeritus and postdoctoral appointments. Rasdeaconu is
Research Associate Professor; Jay Yang and Nicholas Wawrykow are Research Assistant Professors. Confirm
adviser authority/continuity separately. Brazelton starts Spring 2027, and Wanlin Li moved here in August
2025.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
• No dated original paper later than 2022 verified. The newly announced Kerr work has no linked manuscript
and cannot replace the dated 2022 evidence.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD applications from mathematics undergraduate backgrounds are considered; confirm degree
conferral before enrollment. No citizenship prohibition is stated in math admissions. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Complete documents before departmental waiver request; submit application even if awaiting waiver decision.
Enter English-degree information carefully. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Individual faculty cannot assess admission chances; recruitment committee evaluates complete applications.
Research-fit inquiry is distinct from admission prescreening. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
apply.vanderbilt.edu; checklist and recommender controls in public FAQ. [s3]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
Department currently explicitly says Fall 2026; central table confirms annual Dec 1 but no 2027 year. [s1] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL old 89/new 4.5; IELTS 7 described by math; general school also accepts DET 130. Scores valid 2 years;
official agency delivery if needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Entire bachelor's completed or to be completed in US qualifies under detailed rule. Foreign transfer
credits/partial dual degree can invalidate exemption. Waiver checked after complete submission; programs
may impose an exam. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not considered by math; neither required nor used. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional but highly recommended; unofficial/self-reported accepted for review; no minimum. Department page
still carries Fall 2026 label. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math 2026-27 stipend USD 36,500 plus all tuition and student health; payment months/summer split not
specified in checked source.2027-28 rate unverified. [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Usually 5-year support. [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Math offers TA to all successful PhD applicants; Provost Graduate Fellowship extra USD 10,000 explicitly limited
to US citizens/permanent residents. Other fellowship citizenship terms not fully stated. [s1] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA service/training; annual satisfactory-progress conditions in offer need confirmation. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional form for standard funding. [s1]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Arenstorf Fellowship adds USD 5,000 for 1-2 years; University Graduate Fellowship up to USD 5,000; launch
supplement USD 2,000, candidacy USD 500; travel up to USD 1,000/year. Not guaranteed. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 95 after submission; at most 2 programs/year share one fee. Nonrefundable. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
International only departmental discretionary route. Complete and submit, then request before application
deadline if fee due. Math offers limited waivers through linked REDCap form. Do not send tax/SSN documents.
[s1] [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Wanlin Li
Arithmetic geometry and number theory: algebraic curves, abelian varieties, algebraic cycles, finite fields and
L-functions. [faculty1]
Assistant Professor at Vanderbilt since August 2025; older Washington University affiliations are historical. New-student
availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Abelian varieties of prescribed order over finite fields
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Madeline Brandt
Combinatorial and tropical algebraic geometry, moduli of curves/abelian varieties, and their cohomology.
[faculty2] [faculty2a] [brandt_date]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Level structures on tropical abelian varieties
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Thomas Brazelton
Enumerative geometry using motivic and equivariant homotopy theory; quadratic refinements,
monodromy/Galois groups and vector bundles. [faculty4] [faculty4a]
Announced Assistant Professor starting Spring 2027; Fall 2026 Uhlenbeck Postdoc at SLMath. Confirm 2027 student intake
directly.
Research evidence: 2026 · Bitangents to symmetric quartics
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Complex geometry
Rares Rasdeaconu
Real/complex algebraic geometry, real enumerative geometry, Kähler/Hermitian geometry; recent work on
Hilbert squares of real surfaces. [faculty6]
Research Associate Professor. Eligibility and availability to serve as sole primary PhD adviser require confirmation.
Research evidence: 2025 · On the maximality problem for the Hilbert squares of real surfaces
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Complex geometry / differential geometry
Ioana Suvaina
Kähler and non-Kähler complex geometry, balanced and SKT metrics, four-manifolds, Einstein metrics and
Seiberg-Witten theory. [faculty7] [faculty7a] [gapc44] [gapc45] [gapc46]
Current official bio says Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies; old personal homepage still says Assistant
Professor.
Research evidence: 2022; newer paper not verified · Balanced manifolds and SKT metrics
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Research evidence: 2022 journal; 2016 preprint · Balanced manifolds and SKT metrics
Ionuţ Chiose, Rareş Răsdeaconu and Ioana Şuvaina. Official coauthor publication list dates Annali di Matematica Pura ed
Applicata publication to 2022; primary preprint August 31, 2016.
Research evidence: Undated announced work · The dual of the Kerr critical curve
Răsdeaconu's university-hosted homepage, explicitly updated September 6, 2026, lists this under preprints with A. Lupsasca and
I. Suvaina, but supplies no manuscript or submission date. Do not call it a published or fully verified recent paper.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier group: Complex geometry
Earlier interests: Kähler and differential geometry, topology and Seiberg-Witten theory; verified paper studies balanced
manifolds and SKT metrics. Newer research-paper metadata was not verified.
Earlier appointment: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies in current directory; old personal site still says
Assistant Professor.
Evidence qualifications
No dated original paper later than 2022 verified. The newly announced Kerr work has no linked manuscript and cannot replace
the dated 2022 evidence.
Number theory
Larry Rolen
Modular, harmonic Maass and quantum modular forms, partitions, L-values, and arithmetic sequences. [faculty9]
[faculty9a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Oscillating asymptotics and conjectures of Andrews
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Vanderbilt University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• General GRE not considered; math GRE highly recommended.
• International waiver request follows completed submission, but before deadline.
• English exemption can fail with foreign transfer credits.
• The primary-faculty roster mixes research, teaching, emeritus and postdoctoral appointments. Rasdeaconu is
Research Associate Professor; Jay Yang and Nicholas Wawrykow are Research Assistant Professors. Confirm
adviser authority/continuity separately. Brazelton starts Spring 2027, and Wanlin Li moved here in August
2025.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
• No dated original paper later than 2022 verified. The newly announced Kerr work has no linked manuscript
and cannot replace the dated 2022 evidence.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD applications from mathematics undergraduate backgrounds are considered; confirm degree
conferral before enrollment. No citizenship prohibition is stated in math admissions. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Complete documents before departmental waiver request; submit application even if awaiting waiver decision.
Enter English-degree information carefully. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Individual faculty cannot assess admission chances; recruitment committee evaluates complete applications.
Research-fit inquiry is distinct from admission prescreening. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
apply.vanderbilt.edu; checklist and recommender controls in public FAQ. [s3]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
Department currently explicitly says Fall 2026; central table confirms annual Dec 1 but no 2027 year. [s1] [s5]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Prior cycle]
December 1 standing table; department still labels cycle Fall 2026. December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 is not
explicitly verified; timezone unknown. [s1] [s5]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
No separate aid forms; all successful applicants offered TA plus tuition/health. Current-cycle date needs
confirmation. [s1]

Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Unresolved]
This item remains unverified after checking the public program and graduate-admissions instructions. Confirm
it in the current application or directly with the graduate coordinator; no policy is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2]
[s3]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Official scores if required must arrive by program deadline; math permits unofficial subject-GRE for evaluation.
English exemption reviewed after complete submission. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Central guidance says most initial offers by March 31 with response due April 15; exact 2027 offer controls. [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL old 89/new 4.5; IELTS 7 described by math; general school also accepts DET 130. Scores valid 2 years;
official agency delivery if needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Entire bachelor's completed or to be completed in US qualifies under detailed rule. Foreign transfer
credits/partial dual degree can invalidate exemption. Waiver checked after complete submission; programs
may impose an exam. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not considered by math; neither required nor used. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional but highly recommended; unofficial/self-reported accepted for review; no minimum. Department page
still carries Fall 2026 label. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload scanned unofficial transcript from degree institutions, any institution studied at for semester+, or
relevant coursework; official final records after admission. [s2]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate mathematics course-list requirement.
Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited uploads are
permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate course-description/textbook-list
requirement. Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited
uploads are permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
At least 3; academic referees in major field preferred. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]

What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Automated requests can be resent before submission, establishing pre-submission invitations; precise
save/send trigger not public. [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Recommender requests/reminders accessible before and after submission. No separate math grace deadline
verified. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Application Status checklist confirms met/outstanding requirements. SOP is omitted from checklist but
submission itself confirms SOP present. [s3]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Can exclude a recommender before letter received; after all letters received, list cannot be edited. FERPA
change requires excluding/readding. No Interfolio/email letters; reuse across cycles unverified. [s2] [s3]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required; prompt/length/file limits not publicly stated. Upload with application. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required. Prompt paraphrase: why this program, preparation, goals during/after training. General guideline 1-5
pages, no word count; portal may impose math-specific rules. [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay listed in math checklist; portal confirmation needed. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Can address in SOP; separate required statement not listed. [s1] [s2]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list
document; Scholarship essays; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math 2026-27 stipend USD 36,500 plus all tuition and student health; payment months/summer split not
specified in checked source.2027-28 rate unverified. [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Usually 5-year support. [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Math offers TA to all successful PhD applicants; Provost Graduate Fellowship extra USD 10,000 explicitly limited
to US citizens/permanent residents. Other fellowship citizenship terms not fully stated. [s1] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA service/training; annual satisfactory-progress conditions in offer need confirmation. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional form for standard funding. [s1]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Arenstorf Fellowship adds USD 5,000 for 1-2 years; University Graduate Fellowship up to USD 5,000; launch
supplement USD 2,000, candidacy USD 500; travel up to USD 1,000/year. Not guaranteed. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 95 after submission; at most 2 programs/year share one fee. Nonrefundable. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
International only departmental discretionary route. Complete and submit, then request before application
deadline if fee due. Math offers limited waivers through linked REDCap form. Do not send tax/SSN documents.
[s1] [s2]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
Math accepts unofficial subject-GRE but central generic GRE instructions ask official scores. Follow math for
review and confirm official delivery before relying. Detailed English waiver is stricter than generic
English-speaking-university wording. [s1] [s2]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm 2027 deadline/timezone, letter/doc receipt grace,2027-28 months/stipend and fellowship extra
essays/refs, course-list supplements and commitment offer. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Potential advisers and recent research
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Wanlin Li
Arithmetic geometry and number theory: algebraic curves, abelian varieties, algebraic cycles, finite fields and
L-functions. [faculty1]
Assistant Professor at Vanderbilt since August 2025; older Washington University affiliations are historical. New-student
availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Abelian varieties of prescribed order over finite fields
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Madeline Brandt
Combinatorial and tropical algebraic geometry, moduli of curves/abelian varieties, and their cohomology.
[faculty2] [faculty2a] [brandt_date]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Level structures on tropical abelian varieties
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Thomas Brazelton
Enumerative geometry using motivic and equivariant homotopy theory; quadratic refinements,
monodromy/Galois groups and vector bundles. [faculty4] [faculty4a]
Announced Assistant Professor starting Spring 2027; Fall 2026 Uhlenbeck Postdoc at SLMath. Confirm 2027 student intake
directly.
Research evidence: 2026 · Bitangents to symmetric quartics
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Complex geometry
Rares Rasdeaconu
Real/complex algebraic geometry, real enumerative geometry, Kähler/Hermitian geometry; recent work on
Hilbert squares of real surfaces. [faculty6]
Research Associate Professor. Eligibility and availability to serve as sole primary PhD adviser require confirmation.
Research evidence: 2025 · On the maximality problem for the Hilbert squares of real surfaces
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Complex geometry / differential geometry
Ioana Suvaina
Kähler and non-Kähler complex geometry, balanced and SKT metrics, four-manifolds, Einstein metrics and
Seiberg-Witten theory. [faculty7] [faculty7a] [gapc44] [gapc45] [gapc46]
Current official bio says Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies; old personal homepage still says Assistant
Professor.
Research evidence: 2022; newer paper not verified · Balanced manifolds and SKT metrics
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Research evidence: 2022 journal; 2016 preprint · Balanced manifolds and SKT metrics
Ionuţ Chiose, Rareş Răsdeaconu and Ioana Şuvaina. Official coauthor publication list dates Annali di Matematica Pura ed
Applicata publication to 2022; primary preprint August 31, 2016.
Research evidence: Undated announced work · The dual of the Kerr critical curve
Răsdeaconu's university-hosted homepage, explicitly updated September 6, 2026, lists this under preprints with A. Lupsasca and
I. Suvaina, but supplies no manuscript or submission date. Do not call it a published or fully verified recent paper.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier group: Complex geometry
Earlier interests: Kähler and differential geometry, topology and Seiberg-Witten theory; verified paper studies balanced
manifolds and SKT metrics. Newer research-paper metadata was not verified.
Earlier appointment: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies in current directory; old personal site still says
Assistant Professor.
